title: Error Handling and Debugging
description: This module teaches you how to identify, manage, and debug errors in Node.js applications effectively. Learn best practices for error handling, using debugging tools, and writing resilient code.

lessons.title: Understanding Errors in Node.js
lessons.content: Learn about the types of errors you may encounter in Node.js, including syntax errors, runtime errors, and logical errors. Understand how Node.js treats errors and the importance of handling them properly.

lessons.title: Synchronous vs Asynchronous Error Handling
lessons.content: Explore the differences between handling errors in synchronous code versus asynchronous code. Understand the challenges with callbacks, promises, and async/await in error management.

lessons.title: Using try...catch Blocks Effectively
lessons.content: Learn how to use try...catch statements to handle exceptions in your code. See examples of catching synchronous and asynchronous errors, and understand their limitations.

lessons.title: Error Objects and Custom Errors
lessons.content: Understand the Error object in JavaScript and Node.js, including its properties like message and stack. Learn how to create and use custom error classes for better error categorization.

lessons.title: Handling Errors in Callbacks
lessons.content: Learn the traditional error-first callback pattern used in Node.js, how to pass and check for errors, and how to propagate errors through callback chains.

lessons.title: Error Handling with Promises and async/await
lessons.content: Explore error handling techniques when using promises and async/await syntax. Understand how to catch errors with .catch(), try...catch, and error propagation in async functions.

lessons.title: Global Error Handling and Process Events
lessons.content: Learn about global error handlers in Node.js, including 'process.on("uncaughtException")' and 'process.on("unhandledRejection")'. Understand when and how to use them safely.

lessons.title: Debugging Node.js Applications
lessons.content: Get hands-on experience using debugging tools like the built-in Node.js debugger, Chrome DevTools, and VS Code Debugger. Learn to set breakpoints, step through code, and inspect variables.

lessons.title: Using Logging for Error Diagnosis
lessons.content: Understand the importance of logging in debugging and error handling. Learn to use console methods and popular logging libraries like Winston and Morgan for structured and persistent logs.

lessons.title: Writing Resilient and Robust Applications
lessons.content: Discover best practices for writing code that gracefully handles errors and recovers when possible. Learn about retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and designing fault-tolerant applications.
